cleanup() { kill "$tunnel" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$tunnel" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 1 --max-time 20 http://127.0.0.1:18091/api/v1/health/ready >/dev/null
kill -0 "$tunnel"
printf 'REMOTE_DUAL_TUNNEL_READINESS_OK\n'
